استعجبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْجَبُوا (istaʕjabū) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
# اِسْتَعْجِبُوا (istaʕjibū) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
